sentences.japanese: カトリックを信じていない人々でさえ象徴的指導者として法王を敬っている。
sentences.english: Even people who don't believe in the Catholic church venerate the Pope as a symbolic leader.

sentences.japanese: 我々は老人を敬わなければならない。
sentences.english: We should hold old people in reverence.

sentences.japanese: 両親は私に老人を敬うように言った。
sentences.english: My parents told me that we should respect the elderly.

sentences.japanese: 両親は私に年寄りを敬うように言った。
sentences.english: My parents told me we should respect the old.

sentences.japanese: 彼らは彼女を恩人として敬った。
sentences.english: They held her in high esteem as their benefactor.
